question.problem:
Let $R=[2,4]\times [1,5]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=21-xy.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{2,3,4\},\,{P}_{2}=\{1,3,5\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the upper Riemann sum $U(f,P).$
question.worked_solution:
First, let's draw the region $R$ and the partition $P.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/38fcf924a077c207ff66fca76d63333d0f28986432b795c889f22b725faca078.png)

The upper sum $U(f,P)$ is given by

$$
U(f,P)={M}_{11}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{11})+{M}_{21}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{21})+{M}_{12}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{12})+{M}_{22}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{22})
$$

where ${M}_{ij}$ is the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ We pick the *maximum* value of $f$ because we're finding the *upper* sum.

Taking into account the fact that $\text{Area}({R}_{ij})=2$ for all $4$ subregions, the formula for $U(f,P)$ reduces to

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & =2\cdot {M}_{11}+2\cdot {M}_{21}+2\cdot {M}_{12}+2\cdot {M}_{22} \\  & =2({M}_{11}+{M}_{21}+{M}_{12}+{M}_{22}).\end{aligned}
$$

Now, notice that

- $f(x,y)=21-xy$ decreases as $x$ increases, and

- $f(x,y)=21-xy$ decreases as $y$ increases.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/9e1d5a5dcf056f15fdf9e15b4caf3a2f506549ec785c752579bce5b6e12662cb.png)

As a result, the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *smallest* possible $x$ and the *smallest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *bottom left corner* of each subregion.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/609917e6e3e397c9a1bfb4ba92a85535034c657d2bc96ae3b833bea381aea36f.png)

Hence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{11} & =f(2,1)=19 \\ {M}_{21} & =f(3,1)=18 \\ {M}_{12} & =f(2,3)=15 \\ {M}_{22} & =f(3,3)=12\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & =2(19+18+15+12) \\  & =128.\end{aligned}
$$
